race.comment: MRS MAREE (6) tough on-pace mare who returns from a let-up. Chasing her third straight victory today after going nicely through the grades. Kept up to the mark with a 792m tick over trial. Will roll forward and prove hard to get past. COUPLES RETREAT (3) frustrating mare who stalked the good speed and warmed up late to finish third over 1100m at Rosehill in BM78 class. Has to contend with the sticky draw and anywhere near her best could win this. JUST GLAMOUROUS (2) consistent mare who saves her best for this trip. Kept fresh after being nailed late by Glorious Moments when second over 1400m at Randwick. Finds an easier race and since fitted with a 792m trial win. DIDDLE DUMPLING (5) underrated mare resuming. Primed with the two soft trials and can take a hand in the finish if she's on her best behaviour. MONTE KATE (1) had excuses first up and comes to hand quickly. Leading contender from the draw.
